summary: Axon Enterprise filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) covering a $1,000,000,000 offering of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031. The notes are non-interest-bearing, mature September 15, 2031, and carry no stated conversion price yet in this preliminary text. Conversion is conditioned on a 130% stock-price trigger, trading-price parity, redemption calls, or specified corporate events; Axon may redeem on or after September 20, 2029, subject to a 130% hurdle, or via cleanup redemption below 10% outstanding. This is an ordinary convertibles takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, conversion premium, and hedge-driven stock overhang.
